verdict.rationale: Pulumi has well-documented first-party import tooling: `pulumi import` adopts an existing cloud resource into stack state and auto-generates the corresponding program code to manage it, and `pulumi preview --import-file` can bulk-generate an import file/plan across many resources, explicitly framed as a migration path from other IaC tools or manual provisioning. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the import workflow's reliability (community evidence in the pack covers general sentiment, not import specifically).
